parts.text: Deliveries carry a load from one site to another, and inspections take a drone with the right sensors to a list of points in a set order and bring it back to where the inspection started. Drones of several models from different manufacturers differ in how much they can carry, how far they can fly on a full battery, and which sensors they carry, such as cameras, thermal cameras, or laser scanners. Each company's fleet, jobs, sites, and problems are its own business.
